source.title: TNoodle 0.10.0
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-0.10.0 is now available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles), in anticipation of tomorrow's update to the WCA Regulations.

The following change has been made since TNoodle 0.9.0:

- The Pyraminx scrambling limit has been lowered from 7 moves to 6 moves.
<!--break-->

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)

translation.title: TNoodle 0.10.0 发布
translation.content:
为配合明天生效的 WCA 规则更新，TNoodle-WCA-0.10.0 现已可从 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles) 下载。

与 TNoodle 0.9.0 相比，本次作出了以下修改：

* 金字塔打乱所要求的最短还原步数由 7 步降为 6 步。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)
